record.title: uPVC Drainage Pipes - Gravity Drainage Service, Revised Requirements
record.description:
Specifies current dimensional, material, jointing, stiffness, and identification requirements for unplasticized PVC drainage pipes intended for gravity drainage service in buildings and site drainage systems.

Applies to new production and current conformity assessment for the defined uPVC drainage pipe range; the earlier 2023 demo edition is retained only as a superseded historical record.

Key requirements: Pipe dimensions and wall thickness shall meet the revised size-series tolerances.; Ring stiffness classification shall be declared and supported by test evidence.; Joint compatibility shall be demonstrated for the specified socket and seal configuration.; Permanent identification shall include current standard reference and traceability information.

Testing requirements: Dimensional and wall-thickness verification.; Ring stiffness or flattening-related performance test.; Joint watertightness or leakage test.; Impact/workmanship inspection where the declared application requires it.

Documentation required: Current product specification.; Installation and jointing instructions.; Laboratory test evidence.; Traceability and production-control record.

Marking requirements: Manufacturer identification.; Nominal size and stiffness/class designation.; Current standard number: IS DEMO 1011:2026.; Batch/production traceability mark.
record.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where the current product control route adopts this standard; otherwise the standard may support voluntary or contractually required conformity.
